nodes.name: Run Discovery Refresh
nodes.notes: Scrape → normalize → analyze → validate → last-refresh.json → POST MVP with --notify. Requires self-hosted n8n + REPO_PATH. Alternative: GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/discovery-scrape.yml).

parameters.content:
=12h discovery scrape workflow

1. Scrape 7 sources (App/Play Store, Reddit, forums, social, product, QC)
2. Merge → raw-reviews.json (dedupe by text hash)
3. Normalize → pipeline-stats.json
4. pipeline:analyze → themes.json
5. pipeline:validate → validation-results.json
6. Write last-refresh.json + POST /api/workflows/discovery-refresh

Manual collect: MVP /collect or POST /api/collect/reviews

Env: REPO_PATH, MVP_APP_URL, N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET

meta.description: Every 12h: multi-source scrape → merge → normalize → theme analysis → validation → notify MVP API.
